reason: I run three agents a day and the context loss is real, but thirty dollars a seat adds up across all the launch-day tools I try, and I can just re-paste context when I switch. Not worth a monthly bill yet.
objection: Another daemon to install and keep running, plus a recurring charge for a problem I can work around manually.
would_change_my_mind: If my whole small team was under the five free humans and it stayed free, or if context switching actually started costing me billable hours.
